name: Spectral TV
description: Build automatic Jellyfin Live TV channels and resumable on-demand smart channels from shows, seasons, episodes, and movies. Choose balanced, weighted, random, block, alternating, shuffle, fixed-sequence, or custom-pattern programming; keep each show's episode progress independent; insert optional promos and bumpers; use ordinary Jellyfin clients through native Live TV and private per-user playlists; expose the actual enabled Spectral live channels as a Channels row that can be placed from Jellyfin's normal Home screen section settings through Spectral TV's own Jellyfin Web integration; and connect the Spectral M3U/XMLTV sources to Jellyfin Live TV from an explicit one-click admin workflow.
overview: Virtual live and on-demand TV channels for Jellyfin

versions.changelog:
- Keep the Channels row selected after refresh by storing its zero-based slot in Spectral's per-user configuration and reserving that Jellyfin Home slot with the supported Live TV value
- Make a Synchronizing channel card connect Spectral's M3U/XMLTV sources, wait for Jellyfin to import the native channel, and then open it from the same click
- Open already-synchronized channels directly on their real Jellyfin TV-channel page instead of relying on fragile delegated click handling
- Make the Channels Home row display the enabled always-on channels created in Spectral TV instead of a separate placeholder/on-demand channel store
- Map every Spectral stream to its exact native Jellyfin Live TV item so channel cards use normal Jellyfin playback
- Show channel numbers, logos, current-program titles, schedule state, and Live TV synchronization state in the Home row
- Refresh the Channels row periodically so newly created, edited, enabled, or disabled channels appear without reinstalling the plugin
- Return real Live TV channel cards through the optional Home Screen Sections integration instead of private on-demand playlists
- Automatically refresh Jellyfin's Live TV guide after channel creation, editing, or deletion, and self-heal when the Home row detects missing native channel items
- Add runtime diagnostics for Spectral channel count, Jellyfin native Live TV count, and matched-channel count to make future channel-discovery failures immediately visible
- Gate releases against regressions to the obsolete on-demand source, name-based channel matching, placeholder navigation, or non-playable Home cards
- Load the Channels Home bridge as an external, cache-busted plugin asset so browser execution is observable and independent from large inline-script injection
- Never persist the unsupported spectraltvchannels token in Jellyfin's native homesection fields, which Jellyfin coerces back to Live TV after refresh
- Migrate any Channels placement saved by earlier builds into the durable separate slot preference automatically
- Add a real Chromium DOM release gate that executes the delivered bridge and refuses to publish unless all ten Jellyfin Home dropdowns receive a Channels option
- Load Jellyfin's actual web shell in Chromium and require a runtime marker so injected markup without browser execution can never pass the release gate again
- Keep a low-frequency lifecycle safety pass so client-side route reuse cannot leave the Home settings page unpatched
- Remove any obsolete Spectral TV JavaScript Injector registration left behind by earlier builds so the bridge cannot execute twice after upgrading
- Keep all viewer-specific Spectral API requests authenticated even though the lightweight browser bridge can safely load before login completes
- Keep the optional Home Screen Sections integration isolated so its absence cannot block Jellyfin startup or core Spectral TV playback
- Repair partial/legacy Spectral TV databases without destructive channel-table rewrites, and isolate schema families so one old migration cannot block automatic or on-demand channels
- Add a release-gating legacy-schema upgrade probe in addition to the clean Jellyfin 12 Linux smoke test
- Make Channel Studio backend failures identify the failing method, route, and HTTP status instead of every problem appearing as a generic request error
- Simplify Channel Studio search results for dynamic channels, fixed sequences, and promo clips, and keep search results from covering the rest of the page
- Remove internal on-demand progress test controls from the normal interface while retaining non-destructive sequence preview
- Add Channel Studio for automatic Live TV and resumable on-demand smart channels
- Add one-click explicit registration of Spectral TV's M3U tuner and XMLTV guide with Jellyfin Live TV without touching unrelated tuner/provider entries
- Add balanced, weighted, and random live source selection while preserving independent sequential or random episode order
- Add alternating, block, balanced-random, weighted-random, random, shuffle-cycle, fixed-sequence, and custom-pattern on-demand programming
- Add separate promo, bumper, commercial, and station-ID pools that do not corrupt episode progress
- Materialize enabled on-demand channels as private per-user Jellyfin playlists so ordinary clients can play that separate smart-channel mode without a custom client
- Track authenticated per-user progress and safely advance smart playlists only when Jellyfin playback belongs to the linked Spectral TV queue
- Preserve Jellyfin user visibility rules, resume positions, patched dependency auditing, Linux/Synology package sanitization, and startup safety checks
